question: Nivedita buys 6 kg of coffee powder for ₹2,730 per kg and another 12 kg of coffee powder for ₹1,002 per kg. What is the per kg cost (in ₹) of the mixture of 18 kg of coffee powder for her?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of quantities = 6 kg : 12 kg = 1 : 2

Using the weighted average concept:

Mean Price = (1 × 2730 + 2 × 1002) ÷ (1 + 2)

Mean Price = (2730 + 2004) ÷ 3 = 4734 ÷ 3 = 1578

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1578.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
